description: PitchBook public fund profile: fund name, description, quick facts as PitchBook shows them publicly (strategy, status, manager, size, vintage, dry powder when public), domicile address, and the profile's FAQ answers (manager, type, status, notable and latest investments). Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
